name: The Platinum Card® from American Express

welcome_offer.description: Variable welcome offer: up to 175,000 Membership Rewards® points ("apply and find out your welcome offer, as high as 175,000") after you spend $12,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 6 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer; American Express shows the exact amount after you apply. No fixed public offer amount is published.

rules.description: You may not be eligible for a welcome offer if you have or have had this Card, the Platinum Card® from American Express Exclusively for Charles Schwab, the Platinum Card® from American Express Exclusively for Morgan Stanley or previous versions of these Cards.

You also may not be eligible to receive a welcome offer based on various factors, such as your history with credit card balance transfers, your history as an American Express Card Member, the number of credit cards that you have opened and closed and other factors.

recurring_credits.name: Uber Cash
recurring_credits.description: $15/month ($180/yr) + $20 December bonus = $200/yr total. Card must be added to Uber app.

recurring_credits.name: Walmart+ Credit
recurring_credits.description: One monthly Walmart+ membership credit (~$12.95/month plus tax, ~$155/yr).

recurring_credits.name: Airline Fee Credit
recurring_credits.description: $200/yr on incidental fees with one selected airline (baggage, food/drinks, etc.).

recurring_credits.name: Equinox Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $300/calendar year statement credit on Equinox club membership or Equinox+ digital subscription. Issued as single lump sum (changed from $25/monthly per 2026 refresh). Enrollment required.

recurring_credits.name: Digital Entertainment Credit
recurring_credits.description: $20/month ($240/yr) on eligible digital entertainment (Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, NYT, WSJ, Peacock).

recurring_credits.name: Resy Dining Credit
recurring_credits.description: $100/quarter ($400/yr) at US Resy restaurants and eligible Resy purchases.

recurring_credits.name: lululemon Credit
recurring_credits.description: $75/quarter ($300/yr) on lululemon.com or US lululemon stores.
